parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans expression or same-sex conduct, no documented bathroom/border ban, visible scene and Pride, and official tourism welcome are positives. Against this, a documented pattern of street harassment/abuse and police targeting of trans women—including extortion and, in one city, forced naked bathing in dirty water not inflicted on cis sex workers—shows state-implicated hostility. The 2016 arrest survey and 100+/135+ incident counts are dated monitoring figures without denominators, so not prevalence rates. No anti-discrimination recourse is documented, and custody evidence is only a 2025 remark suggesting surgery-gated transfer, leaving non-surgical placement unresolved. This is repeated targeting with thin remedy, but no universal facility/custody rule or organised visitor sweeps: elevated, mid-scale risk.
